aciklama: Tools bound to ONE country's state or payer system, by the key (last route segment) they have in that country. They never exist in another country's build: not as a tool of the country kit (lib/ulke/araclar/), not in another pack, not as a route. Enforced by scripts/ulke-duvarlari.mjs, rule D7, before every country build. Source of the list: docs/COUNTRY-PACK-UZ-TOOLS-AUDIT.md, verdict Remove.
